reconcile.note: Gill reads Psalm 18:41's unanswered cry as God's retributive justice against the wicked, distinct from the sincere seekers promised an answer in Proverbs 8:17 and Matthew 7:8.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.

sides.snippet: They cried, but there was none to save; Even to Yahweh, but he didn't answer them.
sides.verseText: They cried, but there was none to save; Even to Yahweh, but he didn't answer them.

sides.snippet: Those who seek me diligently will find me.
sides.verseText: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
